objective: Close the remaining actual-semantic-layer and continuous published-install gaps in the existing Decisions/card workflow, without replacing the metric engine or owning the agent.
source: Digest-pinned real Cube Core over read-only Postgres; synthetic raw ledger, real /meta, /sql and /load. No Python/SQLite aggregate substitution in the gateway.
prerequisites: Independently recompute all six named metric results from raw ledger rows using Decimal and retain a hand-computable control.
Retain actual Cube metadata, query/response and generated SQL plus model, query, data, runtime and helper identities separately.
Complete a fresh public v0.2.1 terminal install, isolated Codex registration, then agent-authored source/context/card onboarding in that same home; explicitly retain operator manifest setup.
gates_before_cohort: One canonical monthly net-revenue pilot pair.
One explicitly gross-revenue pilot pair that does not inherit the net policy.
One actual source-model-revision pilot pair, unchanged raw ledger; refresh declared bridge lineage by its documented operator path, preserve old approvals and require review before action.
cohort: After explicit review/reapproval and source-owned data correction, ten equivalent prompt pairs on the same new model/data snapshot; five baseline-first, five treatment-first. Pilots remain separate.
fairness: Both arms retain all company source tools and identical reviewed context/card/old notes. Only treatment adds the actual public native MCP and bundled skill. Fresh agent histories, no oracle or desired label in agent prompts.
grading: Correct metric, source-derived definition revision, data snapshot, scope, periods, currency, amounts against independent oracle BEFORE agreement. Actual new-key non-replay receipts for applicable treatment evaluations. Independently review every brief for supported implications, useful next step, citations and no invented cause/send.
stop_rule: Stop on material source/onboarding/pilot error, preserve the attempt, fix the demonstrated defect, then start a separately named attempt. Never rescore or pool repaired episodes as original passes.
nonclaims: One real vendor on synthetic data is not every semantic layer or an actual customer.
Ten prompt pairs are clustered readers, not twenty independent enterprises.
Native probability distributions do not imply calibration or identical frontier prose.
No speed, cost, superiority, human acknowledgement or autonomous external-delivery claim without corresponding evidence.
